Khoj is an open-source, self-hostable personal AI application designed to extend your capabilities by acting as a second brain. It can scale smoothly from running on-device as a personal assistant to functioning as a cloud-scale enterprise AI. Khoj enables you to chat with local or online large language models (LLMs) like GPT, Claude, or LLaMA, and it can provide answers sourced both from the internet and your own documents, supporting various file types such as PDFs, Word documents, and Markdown files.

Key features include creating custom AI agents tailored to your needs, performing advanced semantic search within your documents, automating repetitive research tasks, scheduling notifications, and engaging in voice chat. It supports multimodal interactions, including understanding complex queries that combine data from your documents and the web, generating images, diagrams, and charts, and providing explainable and transparent AI responses to minimize hallucination.

Khoj is designed for flexibility and integration, suitable for individuals and enterprises alike. It runs privately on your computer or can be accessed via their cloud app, with options to customize agents, schedules, and knowledge bases. The platform emphasizes transparency, allowing users to verify the AI’s thought process and the sources used for generating responses.

In summary, Khoj functions as a powerful, customizable AI assistant that manages and enhances access to knowledge from multiple sources in a personalized and autonomous way, offering extensive capabilities from local use to enterprise-scale deployments.[2][3][4][6]
